hero.title: Our Story
hero.lead:
When we met, we never imagined that one day we would find our companion for the journey.

It all began with a beautiful friendship, until one day we discovered we were truly side by side.

Two shy souls, two hearts that dreamed of walking together.

Over time we understood it wasn’t by chance, but that God placed us in each other’s lives for a reason and a purpose.

Through Him we realized that friendship was only the beginning of something deeper.

We recognized His desire: to see us united forever, in marriage, under His blessing.

place.title: The place where it all began
place.lead: Amid lights and songs we met. Among prayers, Sunday hugs and the smiles after church, something simple and strong was born. Here we learned to serve, to believe together, to say “I’m here” for each other. Every time we enter church, we find that first glance again and know that home isn’t just a place: it’s God’s presence and the people beside us.
